explanationMd: Subtract 5 to get −2x≥8. Dividing by −2 reverses the inequality and gives x≤−4.

distractorRationale.c: The boundary is negative four, not positive four.
distractorRationale.b: This gets both the boundary sign and inequality direction wrong.
distractorRationale.a: Dividing by negative two must reverse the inequality.
